definitions.explanation: An error in printed or published text where a wrong character, letter, or word appears. Originally referred to errors in typesetting but now also covers digital text errors.

examples.japanese: {誤植|ごしょく}を{見|み}つけた。
この{本|ほん}には{誤植|ごしょく}が{多|おお}い。
{出版|しゅっぱん}{前|まえ}に{誤植|ごしょく}がないか{丁寧|ていねい}にチェックした。
examples.english: I carefully checked for typos before publication.

notes:
Composed of {誤|ご} (error, mistake) and {植|しょく} (plant, set type). The {植|しょく} refers to {植字|しょくじ} (typesetting), so the word literally means "error in typesetting." Despite its printing origins, it is commonly used for typos in any medium including digital text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤植|ごしょく}を{直|なお}す: to fix a typo
- {誤植|ごしょく}が{多|おお}い: many typos
- {誤植|ごしょく}を{見|み}つける: to find a typo
- {誤植|ごしょく}だらけ: full of typos

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誤字|ごじ}: wrong character — a broader term for any wrong character in writing, not limited to print
- {脱字|だつじ}: omitted character — a missing character rather than a wrong one
- タイポ: typo — the English loanword, used casually in conversation and online
